Employee Rights in the Saudi Private Sector

The key figures for your rights in one place, and every row takes you to a detailed calculator with the method and the article of law.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Your key rights in figures

RightThe rule in briefBasis
End-of-service awardHalf a month's wage for each of the first five years and a full month for each year after, on the last actual wage, with part years pro rata.Article 84
Final settlementThe award by reason, leave pay (Art. 111), notice compensation (Art. 76) and outstanding pay, due within one or two weeks.Articles 84, 88, 111
Domestic workersA month's wage for every 4 consecutive years, two months' compensation for unlawful termination, and 30 days' leave after two years on renewal.Domestic Workers Regulation 1445 AH
Award on resignationNothing before two years, a third from two to five years, two thirds above five and below ten, and the full award from ten years.Article 85
Annual leave21 days a year, rising to 30 after five continuous years with the same employer.Article 109
Notice periodOpen-ended contracts on a monthly wage: 30 days if the worker ends it and 60 if the employer does; compensation is the wage for the notice period.Articles 75 and 76
Termination without a valid reason15 days' wage per year (open-ended) or the wage for the remaining term (fixed-term), with a minimum of two months' wage.Article 77
Sick leave30 days on full pay, then 60 at three-quarters, then 30 unpaid, within a year from the first sick leave.Article 117
Maternity leave12 weeks on full pay, 6 of them compulsory after the birth; GOSI pays 3 months at 100% to women with 12 months of contributions; fathers get 3 days.Articles 151 and 113; Social Insurance Law Arts. 41–42
Special leaveMarriage 5 days; death of a spouse, parent or child 5; a sibling 3; a newborn 3 within 7 days; Hajj 10–15 days; a widow's iddah 4 months and 10 days.Articles 113–116 and 160
OvertimeThe actual hourly wage plus 50% of the basic hourly wage, or time off in lieu with the worker's consent.Article 107
Dismissal without an award9 exhaustive cases in Article 80, provided the worker can object; the award is forfeited.Article 80
Leaving without notice7 cases in Article 81 where the worker may leave and keep the full award.Article 81
GOSI contributionsFor Saudi employees: 9% for pensions (rising for new entrants since July 2024) and 0.75% for SANED, on basic pay and housing, capped at SAR 45,000.Social Insurance Law
Employee costSalary plus the employer's GOSI share (11.75% for Saudis, 2% for expats), the expat levy and iqama, and the end-of-service provision.Social Insurance Law and Art. 40
PensionPrevious system: last 2 years' average × months ÷ 480. New (from 3 July 2024): 2.25% per year and age 65.Social Insurance Law
Retirement age and date65 for new members, 60 Hijri years for those not affected, 58 years 4 months to 65 for affected members; early retirement after 300–360 months.Council of Ministers Resolution 1022
Lump-sum compensationFor those without a pension: old system, last 24 months' average × 10% per month for the first 60 and 12% after; new system, total pension contributions revalued. Paid at the age, on disability or on death, not on resignation.Social Insurance Law and M/273
Work injury100% daily allowance during treatment, a 100% pension for total disability, a proportional pension from 50%, 60 times the notional pension below 50%, and 84 or 60 times for non-Saudis.Social Insurance Law M/273
Nitaqat countingA Saudi counts fully on SAR 4,000 or more and as half from 3,000; the threshold rises to 5,000 on 25 April 2027 and 6,000 on 25 April 2028.Decision 61706 and royal directive
SANED60% of the average wage for 3 months (up to 9,000), then 50% (up to 7,500) for up to 12 months; not paid on resignation.Social Insurance Law
Hafiz (job search allowance)SAR 2,000 for 4 months, then 1,500, 1,000 and 750 for three, SAR 20,250 over 15 months, for Saudis aged 20 to 40, with own income deducted.Human Resources Development Fund
Developed social securitySAR 1,320 for the head of family and 660 per dependent, minus half of earned income and all unearned income, paid on the 1st of each month.Social Security Law 1442H
Social security payment dateThe 1st of each Gregorian month; on a holiday the ministry announces another date, with results on the 25th–27th.HR ministry
Citizen's Account payment dateThe 10th of each Gregorian month; Friday moves to Thursday the 9th and Saturday to Sunday the 11th.Citizen's Account programme
Citizen's Account calculator (maximum)SAR 720 for the head or an independent, 360 and 216 for dependents, capped at 2,088 per household, with no support above SAR 20,000 of income.Program limits (Umm Al-Qura 2023)
Salary date countdownGovernment salaries on the 27th Gregorian; Friday moves to Thursday the 26th and Saturday to Sunday the 28th, with Eid early payment by announcement.Royal directive 2018 and Ministry of Finance
Monthly payment calendarPensions, SANED and social security 1st, Hafiz 5th, Citizen's Account 10th, housing support 24th, disability allowance 26th and salaries 27th, with a countdown for each.MOF, GOSI, HR ministry and HRDF
Pension payment dateThe 1st of each Gregorian month since May 2024 for civil, military and GOSI pensions; Friday or Saturday moves to the Thursday before, with SANED alongside.SAMA circular 2018 and GOSI 2024
Housing support payment dateThe 24th of each Gregorian month; Friday or Saturday moved to the Sunday after in 2026.REDF
Disability allowance payment dateThe 26th of each Gregorian month; weekends move to the next working day.HR ministry
New electricity billFrom 1 January 2027: 21 halalas up to 6,000 kWh and 33 above for homes, fixed fees of SAR 70–100 by breaker, and SAR 500 support for eligible people.Saudi Electricity Company
New water billFrom 1 January 2027: SAR 1 per m³ up to 15, then 2, 4 and 6, sewage at half, and fixed fees of SAR 20 + 10 for a meter up to 20 mm.National Water Company
Dependent fee and iqama renewalSAR 400 a month per dependent for the head of family; the employer pays the expat levy (800 or 700 a month), work permit and iqama fee.Cabinet decisions and Art. 40
Transfer of services (sponsorship transfer) feeSAR 2,000, 4,000 then 6,000 paid by the new employer, plus the levy, work permit and iqama from the transfer date; arrears stay with the previous employer unless the worker is absent.Labor Law Art. 40 and Decision 51848
Housemaid recruitment costCap by nationality (Philippines 14,700, Kenya 9,000, Ethiopia 5,900) plus VAT, SAR 2,000 visa, SAR 600 iqama, and SAR 9,600 a year for a 5th worker.Ministry of Human Resources decisions 2022–2024
Exit re-entry visaSingle SAR 200 for two months and 100 per extra month; multiple 500 for three months and 200 per month; extensions from abroad cost double.Visa fee decision
Finance deduction limitTotal instalments may not exceed a third of salary for employees and a quarter for retirees.SAMA instructions
Home financeTotal DBR 55% for incomes of SAR 15,000 or less and 65% above, finance up to 90% of a first home, admin fee 1% up to 5,000.Responsible lending principles
Iqama finesLate iqama renewal SAR 500, then 1,000, then deportation; unused final exit SAR 1,000; overstaying visitors up to SAR 50,000.Residence system and Passports
Government leave encashmentLast basic salary ÷ 30 for up to 72 days (180 with a pre-2018 balance), and the full balance on death or incapacity.HR Implementing Regulation Art. 133
Civil service salary scaleBasic pay by rank (1–15) and step from SAR 3,000, transport 500 to 1,200, a 9% pension deduction, and the increment on 1 January.Civil Service Law and its regulations
Teachers salary scaleAssistant, practising, advanced and expert teacher ranks by level and step, with transport and the January increment.Education jobs regulation
Health jobs salary scale11 categories × 7 levels × 4 steps: specialists from 7,130, residents from 9,200, consultants from 14,950, with a 70% to 20% full-time allowance.Royal Order 4097/M B (1432H)
Enlisted military salary scalePrivate from 3,220 to Master Sergeant 12,255 over 15 steps, transport 500 or 700, and a 9% pension deduction.Enlisted Service Law (circulated table)
Officers salary scaleFrom Second Lieutenant at 7,590 to Major General at 28,690 (estimate), transport 700, 900 or 1,200, pay on promotion, and a 9% pension.Officers Service Law (circulated estimate)
Engineering jobs salary scale4 categories and 18 levels from 8,650 to 33,900, transport 700 to 1,200, and the 3,000 project management allowance.Engineering Jobs Regulation and Cabinet Decision 407 (2024)
Civil and military retirement pensionLast basic × years ÷ 40 for civilians and months ÷ 420 for the military, capped at the last basic pay.Civil and Military Retirement Laws
Government contractor awardHalf a month's salary per full year after 3 consecutive years, up to SAR 50,000; not reduced on resignation.Non-Saudi contract Art. 18
Public holidaysEid al-Fitr 4 days, Eid al-Adha 4, Founding Day and National Day; work on them is overtime at actual hourly + 50% of basic.Articles 107 and 112, Regulations Art. 24
School holidays countdownAutumn break from 20 November, back 30 November, and every 1448 holiday with the four-city dates.MOE school calendar 1448

The figures above are for private-sector employees under the Labour Law. Every calculator cites its source and last review date. Prefer Arabic? Use the Arabic version.

Frequently asked questions

Which wage are Saudi entitlements based on?

End-of-service pay, leave pay and notice compensation are based on the actual wage: basic pay plus fixed allowances such as housing and transport. Overtime adds 50% of the basic hourly wage to the actual hourly wage.

Did the 2025 amendments change end-of-service pay?

No. Articles 84, 85 and 87 were not amended. The amendments changed notice periods (30 days for the worker, 60 for the employer), maternity leave (12 weeks) and some special leave, and regulated resignation in Article 79 bis.

When must final dues be paid?

Within one week of the end of the contract if the employer ends it, and within two weeks if the worker does (Article 88).
